# `<net/packetring.h>`

<!-- Generated by scripts/gen_docs.py in kagantmr/zuzu. Do not edit. -->

Single-producer, single-consumer ring of Ethernet frames between a NIC driver and netd.

```c
#include <net/packetring.h>
```

## Constants

| Name | Value | Description |
|---|---|---|
| <a id="nic_frame_size"></a>`NIC_FRAME_SIZE` | `1536` | Bytes per frame slot. |
| <a id="nic_ring_depth"></a>`NIC_RING_DEPTH` | `16` | Slots per ring; one stays empty, so a ring holds NIC_RING_DEPTH - 1 frames. |
| <a id="nic_mtu"></a>`NIC_MTU` | `1500` | Largest IP packet in a frame. |
| <a id="nic_ring_bytes"></a>`NIC_RING_BYTES` | `sizeof(NicRing)` | Size of one ring (24648 bytes). |
| <a id="nic_ring_stride"></a>`NIC_RING_STRIDE` |  | Ring size rounded up to whole pages (28672 bytes). |
| <a id="nic_rx_offset"></a>`NIC_RX_OFFSET` | `0u` | Offset of the rx ring in the shared memory. |
| <a id="nic_tx_offset"></a>`NIC_TX_OFFSET` | `NIC_RING_STRIDE` | Offset of the tx ring in the shared memory. |
| <a id="nic_shm_bytes"></a>`NIC_SHM_BYTES` | `(2u * NIC_RING_STRIDE)` | Size of the shared memory: 14 pages. |

## Structures

### `NicFrame` { #nicframe }

One frame slot.

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `len` | `uint32_t` | Bytes of `data` in use. |
| `data` | `uint8_t` | Frame bytes. |

### `NicRing` { #nicring }

A ring of frames in shared memory; empty when head == tail.

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `slots` | [`NicFrame`](#nicframe) | Frame slots. |
| `head` | `volatile uint32_t` | Next slot the producer writes. |
| `tail` | `volatile uint32_t` | Next slot the consumer reads. |

## Functions

### `PacketRingPush` { #packetringpush }

```c
int PacketRingPush(NicRing *r, void *src, uint16_t len);
```

Producer: copies a frame into the ring.

| Parameter | Direction | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `r` | inout | Ring. |
| `src` | in | Frame bytes. |
| `len` | in | Frame length, at most NIC_FRAME_SIZE. |

**Returns:** 0, or an error code.

| Error | Condition |
|---|---|
| [`ERR_OVERFLOW`](../../errors.md#err_overflow) | `r` or `src` is NULL, or `len` is too large. |
| [`ERR_BUFFULL`](../../errors.md#err_buffull) | The ring is full. |

### `PacketRingPop` { #packetringpop }

```c
int PacketRingPop(NicFrame *dst, NicRing *r);
```

Consumer: copies the oldest frame out of the ring.

| Parameter | Direction | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `dst` | out | Where to copy the frame. |
| `r` | inout | Ring. |

**Returns:** 0, or an error code.

| Error | Condition |
|---|---|
| [`ERR_BADARG`](../../errors.md#err_badarg) | `dst` or `r` is NULL. |
| [`ERR_BUFEMPTY`](../../errors.md#err_bufempty) | The ring is empty. |
| [`ERR_OVERFLOW`](../../errors.md#err_overflow) | The slot claimed an impossible length; it has been skipped. |

### `PacketRingReserve` { #packetringreserve }

```c
NicFrame * PacketRingReserve(NicRing *r);
```

Producer: returns the next free slot to fill in place, without copying.

Fill in its data and len, then call PacketRingCommit().

| Parameter | Direction | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `r` | in | Ring. |

**Returns:** The slot, or NULL if the ring is full or `r` is NULL.

### `PacketRingCommit` { #packetringcommit }

```c
void PacketRingCommit(NicRing *r);
```

Producer: publishes the slot from PacketRingReserve().

A barrier orders the slot's contents before the new head.

| Parameter | Direction | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `r` | inout | Ring. |

### `PacketRingPeek` { #packetringpeek }

```c
NicFrame * PacketRingPeek(NicRing *r);
```

Consumer: returns the oldest frame to read in place, without copying.

Call PacketRingConsume() when done with it.

| Parameter | Direction | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `r` | in | Ring. |

**Returns:** The slot, or NULL if the ring is empty or `r` is NULL.

### `PacketRingConsume` { #packetringconsume }

```c
void PacketRingConsume(NicRing *r);
```

Consumer: releases the slot from PacketRingPeek() back to the producer.

| Parameter | Direction | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `r` | inout | Ring. |
